connectors.name: Telegram

availability.note: Selection and connection evidence are modeled, but no commerce.workflow Telegram adapter is registered in the runtime yet.

limitations: A selected tool does not create or authorize a bot connection by itself.

connectors.name: X

availability.note: Selection is supported, but production publishing depends on a separately configured X provider adapter and account permissions.

limitations: API access level and posting or analytics permissions vary by the connected X account.

connectors.name: Telegram Stars

availability.note: Catalog and entitlement support are present; a production Stars payment adapter is not included in this foundation.

limitations: Telegram Stars is for Telegram digital goods and services and is not a general-purpose card processor.
Settlement, refund, and dispute behavior remains subject to Telegram platform rules.

connectors.name: Stripe

availability.note: Rockstar_ibot has Stripe billing primitives, but merchant commerce execution requires separate account connection and adapter wiring.

limitations: Selection does not create products, prices, tax configuration, or a merchant account.

connectors.name: Email

availability.note: Transport primitives exist, while production commerce campaigns require a tenant sender connection, consent controls, and adapter wiring.

limitations: The connector does not establish recipient consent or guarantee inbox delivery.

connectors.name: Landing Page

availability.note: Entitlement can be selected now; managed hosting and publication adapters are not part of this foundation.

limitations: Selection does not provision hosting, a domain, analytics, or a deployment target.

connectors.name: LMS

availability.note: The catalog reserves a generic LMS boundary; no vendor-specific production adapter is included.

limitations: Course, enrollment, and completion semantics differ by LMS and require a vendor-specific adapter.

connectors.name: Software License

availability.note: Selection is modeled, but license generation, signing, activation, and revocation require a provider adapter.

limitations: This foundation does not generate or retain license-signing material.

connectors.name: Community

availability.note: The connector boundary is vendor-neutral; no Discord, Slack, Circle, or other community adapter is selected here.

limitations: Membership roles and access semantics require a provider-specific adapter.

connectors.name: Brain Import

availability.note: This release defines selection and metadata only; it does not include an importer.

limitations: Only an explicitly supplied export artifact may be imported; there is no live account scraping.
No continuous sync, merge conflict resolution, provider writeback, or complete-fidelity guarantee is provided.
An imported snapshot is untrusted source material until provenance and format validation succeed.
